origin.description: Pipe variant that builds one nested expression.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A value, or the dot placeholder.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call, using the same placement rules as %>%.

origin.details: The chain is rewritten into one nested call and then evaluated. Pure functions match %>%. A step with more than one placeholder is an error. Because the nested call is still lazy, messages print from the last step backward.
origin.value: The result of the nested call, or a function when the left-hand side is the dot.

translation.description: Nested pipe. Pure functions match pipe.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The starting value, or DOT to return a functional sequence.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: The same callable and (function, args, kwargs) steps as pipe. More than one DOT in a step raises ValueError.

translation.details: A value chain is evaluated lazily, so results and side-effect order match pipe. Two top-level DOT placeholders in one step raise ValueError with the message "Can't use multiple placeholders." A chain that starts at DOT is still an FSeq and may use the dot more than once.
translation.value: The piped value, or an FSeq when lhs is DOT.
translation.example:
from magrittr.pipe import pipe_nested
pipe_nested(list(range(1, 11)), sum)
